newsitem.title: USA: Miller Industries Aug/Sept net $2.0 mln.
newsitem.headline: Miller Industries Aug/Sept net $2.0 mln.

text.p: Miller Industries Inc said Friday it earned $2.0 million, or $0.09 a share, on net sales of $41.6 million for the August 1-October 3 period.
Net income per share is adjusted to reflect a September 30 two-for-one stock split, the company said.
Miller did not provide comparison figures for the same period last year.

Miller, which manufactures vehicle towing and recovery equipment in North America and Europe, said it released the August-September results to comply with certain pooling-of-interests accounting requirements relating to its September acquisition of Vulcan International.
